description: Held-Out Multi-Constellation Replication in Public MGEX RINEX Data

methodology.data_source: Public MGEX RINEX 3/4 observation files + merged BRDC/MGEX broadcast ephemerides (NASA CDDIS / IGS)
methodology.key_innovation: Strict held-out per-constellation replication with frozen predictions
methodology.processing: Single Point Positioning (SPP) per constellation, iono-free L1/L2
